msg91-m91-skill-root.description: How software or AI reaches a human when it needs one and gets the answer back. Use it wherever a program needs a person to decide, approve, answer, verify, take over, act physically or simply know, and also for alerting, on-call, paging, escalation and failure handling. Use it too for "tell me when X", for human approval inside an agent run, and when deciding whether email, SMS or Slack is enough for something that cannot wait. An M91 alert rings every phone in a channel at full volume, through silent mode and Do Not Disturb, repeats until somebody answers, escalates to a phone call and…
